title: Stage Surcharge Schedule for Dropped Batches — Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts
content:
When a dropped-batch violation is booked on a Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts account, a stage surcharge follows how far the batch had gone and how many customers it held. Both facts are read from the dropped batch's own record in Cartwise Shopper Batches: whether a shopping start time is recorded on the batch, and the number of orders the batch carried.

## Schedule

| Shopping had started on the batch | Orders the batch carried | Stage surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Two or more | 2 points |
| Yes | One | 1 point |
| No | Any number | No stage surcharge |

**Clause.** When shopping had started on the batch and the batch carried two or more orders, the stage surcharge is 2 points; when shopping had started and the batch carried a single order, it is 1 point; when shopping had not started there is no stage surcharge.

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A Triple Delivery Batch dropped after the shopper started shopping: shopping started, three orders — 2 points.
- A Single Delivery Batch dropped mid-shop: shopping started, one order — 1 point.
- A Double Delivery Batch dropped before any item was picked, with no shopping start time on its record: no stage surcharge, whatever the order count.

## Points of judgement

- The order count is the batch's own count of orders.
- A single-order batch never reaches 2 points on this schedule, however far shopping had gone.
